# Acid migration fixtures

Synthetic factory-preset projects produced by the preceding Rhythmer native test, not captured user music. Files 0-4 cover former X0X SAW and four HT sounds; notes, ties and parameter values are known fixtures. The frozen Hortator kernel is the pre-cache GPL-3.0 reference from the pinned Hortator adapter, with href_ names to compare exact PCM. No X0X audio implementation is included.
